text: 2026-09-22 owner decision: P1a adopted. 1.0 ships film-capable types plus annotation/caption-assisted video mapping; compileFilm (bd-01M2T32SGVJXR2RT3RTS2DCN9P, F1-F6) and D1B end-to-end proofs (bd-01M1CQNM5DZZNWD8BN4WRKVZRQ) become 1.1 work at P2, and the release gate bd-01M2TAMJ95K9D7H248A8387YW4 drops its D1A-film, D1B and D1A-types edges (applied in the same change). Rationale: the Sherlock mapping runs without the film compiler; the film compiler still needs annotations or captions as input; the 2026-09-17 freeze rationale is met by the closed D1A-types and D1B signatures; compileFilm is additive. P1b is moot (H5 no longer gates film).
